title: Card Benefit Terms: Completion Card Bonus on Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry Purchases
content:
**Card benefit.** When the registrant of a Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry redeems the completion discount on her or his own order line (a purchase record of a registry item still in ordered status), a completion card bonus is added to the line's completion percent, in percentage points, according to the Marlowe & Finch card account the order line is charged to — an account of the Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards program, read from that account's status and card product:

- when that account is active on the date the discount is redeemed and is a Marlowe & Finch Store Card Elite or a Marlowe & Finch World Elite Mastercard, the elite card completion bonus of **8** percentage points applies;
- when that account is any other active Marlowe & Finch card account, the greater of the registry type's completion card bonus percent and the standard card completion bonus of **3** percentage points applies;
- otherwise no completion card bonus is added.

### The "any other active card" bonus by registry type

| Registry type | Registry type's completion card bonus percent | Standard card completion bonus | Bonus applied (the greater) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Celebration Registry | 0 | 3 | 3 |
| Graduation Registry | 0 | 3 | 3 |
| Housewarming Registry | 0 | 3 | 3 |
| Baby Registry | 0 | 3 | 3 |
| Anniversary Registry | 0 | 3 | 3 |
| Wedding Registry | 5 | 3 | 5 |

### Cases (hypothetical)

| Card account the line is charged to | Account status | Registry type | Points added |
|---|---|---|---|
| Marlowe & Finch World Elite Mastercard | active | any | 8 |
| Marlowe & Finch Store Card Elite | active | any | 8 |
| Marlowe & Finch Store Card Plus | active | Wedding Registry | 5 |
| Marlowe & Finch Platinum Mastercard | active | Baby Registry | 3 |
| Marlowe & Finch Store Card Elite | closed | any | none |
| no Marlowe & Finch card account (paid by other means) | — | any | none |

The account that counts is the one the order line itself is charged to; an elite account the registrant holds but did not charge the line to does not decide the bonus.
